newsitem.title: USA: IMM marks and Swiss hit contract lows, end lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM marks and Swiss hit contract lows, end lower.

text.p: IMM mark and Swiss franc futures languished all afternoon and ended lower, with March yen still in positive territory but well off session highs.
Marks and Swiss eked out small gains in choppy early trade before stumbling to fresh contract lows as stocks dramatically reversed from their early collapse.

Stocks and the dollar recovered amid belief that strong U.S. jobs growth in December was a positive sign for the economy and could lead to a rate hike in February. March Treasury bond futures collapsed more than a point and never recovered after the strong jobs data.
December jobs rose 262,000, versus the 192,000 estimate. The unemployment rate equalled November's revised 5.3 percent.
"I think the report itself gave credibility to a rate hike and basically fueled the fire for further dollar strength," one IMM trader said.
Early in the session, dollar/mark sank as stock and bond weakness mounted, but as stocks stabilized the dollar rose near fresh 29-month highs against marks.
In sterling, March posted a technically significant outside-day-down, possibly a bearish signal for next week, technicians said.
March sterling posted a one-week high in overnight trade but collapsed to close at the lowest price since late December.
Traders tied weakness in sterling to soft U.K. manufacturing and output data overnight and to worries about repatriation of Japanese capital to rescue the ailing Nikkei.
Traders noted good IMM volume but said mark and Swiss activity tapered off into the close.
Canadian dollar remained firm, underpinned by recent technical and fundamental bullishness. March reached the highest price since early December.

Technicians pegged support heading into next week at $0.6275 in marks and at $0.7275 in Swiss. One trader said $0.7340 was good intraday resistance in March Swiss and said that was a level to watch early Monday. March Swiss closed down $0.0020 at $0.7321.

At settlement, March yen was up $0.000024 to $0.008696, marks fell $0.0025 at $0.6338, pound lost $0.0178 to $1.6750, Can dollar was up $0.0014 at $0.7446, Aussie dollar rose $0.0007 to $0.7808, Mex peso rose $0.000300 to $0.123575.
